svg.title: Ilya project map, 5 August 2026, updated at the close of E.27. The reference map.
svg.desc: A whole-project map of Ilya and its Fit pane, drawn to be updated rather than replaced. It carries the ratified beta line in Dann's own words at the top, then eight zones and a gate tracker. Zone one, what a singer opens: Transcribe, Fit, Learn, and Guide. Zone two, Fit's pipeline: Calibrate, Ingest, Resolve, Analyse, and Engrave; the calibration gate measures, and item 1.8 closed on 5 August so the printed result now states what it withholds. Zone three, the measurement layer built in episode twenty and wired in episode twenty-one, every part of which computes correctly and still reaches no pixel. Zone four, the engine packages with their measured test counts. Zone five, the advice layer. Zone six, the score reader. Zone seven, the photograph path. Zone eight, the design system. Then the gate tracker: six gates, A through E plus P, every item marked closed, open, yours to decide, or farmed to Sonnet, with a new defect D9, the stemless melody notes. Finally what is cut from this release and what lies ahead, and a legend of six outline states. Outline rather than colour carries status throughout, so the map survives greyscale.
svg.text: project map, 5 August 2026, UPDATED at the close of E.27. THE REFERENCE MAP: update this file, do not start a new one. Branch Shane, PUSHED at a86661b.
Done means this, and only this · ratified by Dann, 30 July 2026, in his own words
“A singer can, on their own device, in one sitting: use Transcribe, Fit, Learn, and Guide effectively for the purposes they were created. Users can calibrate their voice
with real audio through a gate that measures; upload a score in a supported digital format including PDF and photograph; and read or print a complete Fit result
that never guesses where calibration is absent. We may also incorporate some of the analysis graphs I feature in Chapter 6 of my dissertation if they prove to add value.”
“A gate that measures” CLOSED 4 Aug, E.26. “Never guesses where calibration is absent” CLOSED 5 Aug, E.27, item 1.8: the print says what it withholds, walked EN and FR.
Photographed Cyrillic TEXT ships too: tesseract.js
Does this piece suit my voice?

E.26 found four live defects here, three by Dann using the app. E.27 found three more the same way: two in its own new control, and the stemless notes, which no suite we own has an opinion about.

Still one step short of a singer. 5 Aug: the Fit page now carries the 1.6 legend, its own title, and a withheld statement when no voice has been measured.
Those are statements about PROVENANCE. The forty-eight measurement fields above remain unread by any pixel and are a separate matter. Do not conflate them.
4 · What powers it · @ilya/web MEASURED 5 August in Dann's terminal · the rest carried from 2 August
Gate E5 CLOSED. None of the 7 in shane/
A green number only vouches for what its instrument read. E.27 ran four gate pairs, every one matching an expectation written before it ran, and the suite still had
nothing to say about a page full of stemless notes. vitest transpiles without typechecking and never compiles a .svelte file. svelte-check is what looks at those.

Curvature: vanishing point and spline interpolation, for a bound book that will not lie flat
Outline carries status, never colour, so this map survives greyscale. A band marked CARRIED was not re-verified in this pass. Counts marked MEASURED were read from Dann's own terminal.
To update: change the date in the credit line and the filename, move the outline classes, and re-file the gate marks. Do not start a new file; this one is the reference.
